lines.beaver: 이번에 우리 팀에 오는 지훈 씨 알아요?
lines.beaver_en: Do you know Jihun, who's joining our team?
lines.beaver_roman: ibeone uri time oneun jihun ssi arayo?
lines.en: Yes, according to rumors, he's easygoing.

lines.beaver_en: That's a relief. He used to be passive, right?
lines.en: Yes, he was passive, but now he's active.

lines.beaver_en: Really? Did you hear anything else?
lines.en: I heard he's considerate and wise.

lines.beaver_en: Nice. But doesn't he have any weak points?
lines.en: If anything, they say he's a bit proud.
They say he's funny, saying unexpected things.
Right. They say he's pure and very human.
No, they say he's not selfish at all.
They say he's childish sometimes but mature at work.

lines.beaver_en: There are no negative rumors at all.
lines.learner: 팀장님 말에 의하면 부정적인 말을 안 한대요.
lines.en: According to the manager, he never talks negatively.
lines.roman: timjangnim mare uihamyeon bujeongjeogin mareul an handaeyo.

lines.beaver: 이제야 마음이 놓이네요. 빨리 만나고 싶어요.
lines.beaver_en: Now I feel at ease. I want to meet him soon.
lines.beaver_roman: ijeya maeumi noineyo. ppalli mannago sipeoyo.
lines.en: Me too. Let's welcome him together next week.
